structures.description: Multi-month bull swing from the 1368.42 low to the 2850 high, with successively higher swing lows (1512.91, 1533.12, 2357.18, 2436.87, 2633.31) across the supplied window.

Three-bar vertical bull spike following a long two-sided range: open 1916.51 to close 2252.16 (1787097600000), close 2326.32 (1787184000000), then a 2771 high with a 2515.3 close and a large upper tail (1787270400000).

Twenty-seven-bar two-sided range after the spike: repeated highs 2520-2557 plus the 2680 spike high at 1789084800000, and repeated lows 2357-2400 with 2357.18 at 1788307200000 and 2358.62 at 1789430400000; no sustained close beyond either edge.
Four-bar bull breakout above the 27-bar range and above the 2771 spike high, closing near highs at 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.9 and 2775.61, with the 2850 high printed at 1789948800000.

Tight seven-bar consolidation just under the 2850 high; the last four bars are small overlapping dojis traded between 2636.28 and 2740.42, with no close beyond the 2612.02 breakout close and final close 2687.88.

evidence_for: Progression of higher swing highs and higher swing lows over the last 40 bars: lows 2357.18 (1788307200000), 2358.62 (1789430400000), 2436.87 (1789689600000) and 2633.31 (1790208000000).
1789689600000-1789948800000 broke above the 27-bar range and above the prior 2771 spike high, with closes near the highs and acceptance above 2612.02.
The last seven bars hold entirely above the 2612.02 breakout close and above the 2436.87 breakout-low; no bear bar has closed below a prior bull swing low.
Buying continued after each consolidation: ranges following the 2293.8/2771 spike highs and after the 27-bar range were all resolved upward.
evidence_against: The 2850 high was not followed by a trend bar: 1790035200000 is an inside bar and 1790121600000 closed 2684.16 below its open, leaving 1790639999999 162 points under the high.
1787270400000 left a ~256-point upper tail (high 2771 vs close 2515.3), and the following 27 bars could not exceed 2680, showing repeated failure to hold new highs.
The final four bars are near-doji small-range bars (2636.28-2740.42), a tight two-sided cluster at the trend extreme that fits a final-flag shape rather than trend resumption.
Two earlier vertical spikes in this window (1787097600000, 1787270400000) were each followed by multi-week ranges, so a stall after the 2850 high is consistent with this window's prior behavior.
transition_conditions: Bull continuation: a close above 2786.81 and then 2850 on a trend bar with follow-through, and a higher low above 2633.31, would confirm resumption of the bull channel.
A bear body closing below 2633.31 and then below the 2612.02 breakout close would suggest the breakout has failed and shift the read toward a trading range or transition-unclear.
A close below 2436.87 would break the most recent bull swing low and question the always-in-long classification.
Continued overlapping bars contained between 2633.31 and 2786.81 with no boundary close would keep the current read of a bull trend in a breakout-mode tight range.
